title: Sundance and Independent Spirit winning films and their directors

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?dirLabel ?kindTag WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?d) AS ?dir) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?d) AS ?nDir) (MAX(?doc) AS ?isDoc) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q11424 ; wdt:P166 ?aw ; wdt:P57 ?d ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . ?aw rdfs:label ?al . FILTER(lang(?al) = "en" && (CONTAINS(?al, "Sundance") || CONTAINS(?al, "Independent Spirit")) && !CONTAINS(?al, "Short")) BIND(IF(CONTAINS(?al, "Documentary"), 1, 0) AS ?doc) FILTER(?sl >= 15) FILTER(?d NOT IN (wd:Q51552, wd:Q25089, wd:Q42229, wd:Q220751, wd:Q298025)) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nDir = 1) BIND(IF(?isDoc = 1, "documentary", "drama") AS ?kindTag) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160
